Criterion: Verify that all fluids that can be collected within the pod are capable of being drained safely. Standard: Collected fluids within the aerial refueling pod are capable of being drained without causing hazards to the air vehicle, other aircraft or creating a potential hazard to personnel. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration and review of documentation. Analysis, drainage demonstration and flight test verifies collected fluids within the aerial refueling pod are capable of being drained without causing hazards to the air vehicle, other aircraft or creating a potential hazard to personnel. References: JSSG-2009: 3.3.8, 4.3.8
